title: Juelz Sun God Festival '26 Multi-Cam Set
description:
Juelz — UCSD Sun God Festival '26 Multi-Cam Set

As Creative Director, I led the first-ever student-produced multi-camera concert production at UCSD's Sun God Festival 2026. I directed the creative vision, coordinated production, operated camera, and edited the final multicam set for electronic music producer and DJ Juelz.

Filmed during the largest Sun God Festival in the event's 40-year history, this project was captured in front of a sold-out crowd of over 20,000 attendees. It showcases my ability to lead live productions from concept to final delivery while creating dynamic, cinematic concert content.

title: SUNGOD FESTIVAL 2026
description: Camera operator for the official Sun God Festival 2026 recap video, collaborating with a team of student filmmakers to capture the energy, performances, and atmosphere of UCSD's largest annual music festival. Filmed during the largest Sun God Festival in the event's 40-year history, this project captured a sold out crowd of over 20,000 attendees. Contributed dynamic live event coverage that helped showcase the festival experience through a fast paced, cinematic recap.

title: GOLDENVOICE SURF CLUB
description:
Media photographer at Goldenvoice Surf Club during Coachella Weekend 2026, capturing live performances and crowd energy throughout the event. Shot electronic dance music DJs and producers including Subtronics, ROZ, Blossom, and Shepherd, focusing on both artist performance moments and audience atmosphere.

The project documents the scale and intensity of the festival environment, blending live performance photography with candid crowd coverage to reflect the full experience of the event.

title: HORIZON RECAP VIDEO 2026
description: Filmed and edited a recap video for UC San Diego's Horizon Music Festival, documenting the event's most successful year to date. The video captures live performances, crowd energy, and key moments throughout the festival, including artists such as UMI and Grent Perez. The project focuses on translating the atmosphere of the event into a cohesive, cinematic recap.

title: DEVDEA - Live at NOVA - San Diego - 2/20/2026 - (ACRAZE DIRECT SUPPORT)
description: Camera operator for a multi-camera live performance set featuring DJ and producer DEVDEA at NOVA San Diego. Captured dynamic performance coverage as part of a coordinated multicam production while DEVDEA performed as direct support for ACRAZE.

title: ASCE SUNGOD TAKEOVER TEASER 2026
description: Camera operator and creative collaborator on a mixed-media teaser as part of the Sun God Festival 2026 media and marketing campaign. Contributed to capturing and shaping visual content designed to promote and build anticipation for the festival through dynamic, high impact promotional storytelling.

title: CODE RED - PALACIO - RECAP VIDEO
description: Filmed and edited a creative video for electronic dance music DJ and producer Palacio, capturing the movement, lighting, and atmosphere of his live DJ set at CODE RED in Los Angeles. The project focuses on translating the energy of the performance into a dynamic visual experience through intentional camera work and pacing.

title: SPOTLIGHT LA - TALON B2B LUCIANO
description: Filmed and edited a cinematic performance piece capturing the explosive B2B set from TALON and Luciano at Spotlight LA. Designed to translate the intensity of the night into a high energy visual experience, blending kinetic camera work, pulsing lighting, and crowd energy to reflect the atmosphere of the club in real time. The edit focuses on rhythm, movement, and immersion, mirroring the pace and power of the live set.

title: Sun God Festival — Campaign Photography
description: Photographed and edited a photo series for the Sun God Festival campaign, collaborating with Triton Outfitters, UCSD Skate Club, and the Sun God Festival committee. The work supported promotional and marketing efforts for the festival, capturing styled visuals that highlight campus culture, community, and event branding.

title: Alpha Phi - Executive Board Photos 2025
description: Studio photographer for Alpha Phi's 2025 Executive Board, capturing formal portrait sessions for organizational and leadership representation. Focused on clean, polished compositions and professional lighting to highlight each member while maintaining a cohesive visual identity across the board.

title: YOU ARE THE VISUAL — Interactive Installation
description:
YOU ARE THE VISUAL is an interactive audiovisual installation inspired by EDM and rave culture, where the viewer becomes the performer. Built using a Kinect V2 sensor and TouchDesigner, the system tracks full body movement in real time and translates it into generative visuals and sound.

As users move through the space, their gestures directly shape geometry, motion, color, and audio output, turning the body into both instrument and interface. No two experiences are the same, with each interaction producing unique visual and sonic results based on how the participant moves.

The project explores real-time performance, embodiment, and the relationship between human movement and digital environments, creating a reactive system where the audience is the content.

title: Grent Perez — Horizon Festival 2026
description: Glide camera operator for Grent Perez's performance at UC San Diego's Horizon Festival 2026. Captured smooth, cinematic moving shots of the live performance, contributing dynamic visuals that showcased the energy of the artist, audience, and festival atmosphere.

title: XPO Fit Challenge - Gran Fondo 2025
description: As part of my marketing internship with Radicle Science, I filmed and edited a promotional recap video for the XPO Fit Challenge Gran Fondo 2025. The project captured the energy of the cycling event while highlighting the participant experience and sponsor activations, including Chiquita, Ann's Supplements, and VOX Nutrition. The final video was created to support Radicle Science's marketing efforts through engaging, story-driven event coverage.

title: SLOW ROLL - A SHORT FILM
description:
Directed, co-wrote, produced, edited, and served as one of the cinematographers for SLOW ROLL, a narrative short film created as part of my coursework at UC San Diego. This project challenged me to lead every stage of the filmmaking process, from development through post-production, while collaborating with a talented cast and crew to bring the story to life.

After a drug deal goes wrong, a small-time con artist is dragged into an underground poker room where every hand decides life or death, forcing him to confront betrayal, fate, and the twisted truth of who's really in control.

title: CORNER POCKET - A SHORT FILM
description: Served as the Director of Photography, cinematographer, and screenwriter for CORNER POCKET, collaborating closely with the production team to bring the story to life through intentional visual storytelling. From crafting the screenplay to developing the film's cinematic look, I focused on using composition, lighting, and camera movement to create a compelling narrative from script to screen.
